# Delivered Client Fixture

`s2-client.py` is the exact generated client from upstream commit
`d61e8d51cfe6589eb258b53fa0abfcb4d7512041`, SHA-256
`8c0ab875cfe3d3d133801c911e361fefe015a20f28121336da5b3a6fb8ed169c`.
